name: Titanium.UI.iOS.ViewAttachmentBehavior
summary: Dynamic behavior to support connections between two items.
description:
A view attachment behavior creates a dynamic connection between two items. To define a view
attachment behavior:

  1. Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createViewAttachmentBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createViewAttachmentBehavior) method to create and define a behavior.
  2. Set the [anchorItem](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.ViewAttachmentBehavior#anchorItem) and
     [item](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.ViewAttachmentBehavior#item) properties.
  3. Add the behavior to the [Animator object](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Animator).

To create a dynamic connection between an item and anchor point, use [Titanium.UI.iOS.AnchorAttachmentBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.AnchorAttachmentBehavior).

examples.title: Simple Example

properties.name: anchorItem
properties.summary: Item to use as the anchor in this behavior.

properties.name: anchorOffset
properties.summary: Offset from the center point of the anchor item for the attachment.

properties.name: damping
properties.summary: Amount of damping to apply to the attachment behavior.

properties.name: distance
properties.summary: Distance, in points, between the two attachment points.

properties.name: frequency
properties.summary: Frequency of oscillation for the behavior.

properties.name: item
properties.summary: Item to connect to use the attachment behavior.

properties.name: itemOffset
properties.summary: Offset from the center point of the item for the attachment.
